value.rationale: At the smallest nontrivial distinct-size additive balance 2:3:4:7, a fourth independent shore stores an arbitrary persistent word while other three flip; produces exact \(2^{2k}\) distinct two-cycles despite pairwise distinct sizes, contrasting with the single orbit in distinct-size tripartite networks. This is a structural motif and full infinite-family exact classification, not an arbitrary finite test.
